incident.title: Outgoing confirmation emails remain queued
incident.description: Orders appear in our dashboard but customers are not receiving confirmation emails. We noticed this at 10:00 UTC. Sending a test message did not help. We do not know whether the issue affects every recipient.

context.reported_impact: Two sampled outbound messages are deferred; total queue size unknown.
